scope: Additive vocabulary for BlueprintBench. Core PALO 3.1 release and its digest-bound artifacts retain their existing versions.

classes.label: Evaluation programme
classes.definition: A versioned programme that defines evaluation tasks, protocols and publication rules.

classes.label: Index definition
classes.definition: A proposed or adopted specification for an aggregate index, including eligibility, formula and version.

classes.label: Evaluation cohort
classes.definition: A declared set of source families and tasks with a split, revision and reuse conditions.

classes.label: Source repository
classes.definition: A coherent source collection identified by provenance, size and content fingerprints.

classes.label: Model configuration
classes.definition: Model revision, provider/runtime, quantisation, reasoning, context and pipeline settings bound to a run.

classes.label: Evaluation run
classes.definition: A recorded execution under one declared configuration and cohort; failures remain in the record.

classes.label: Metric definition
classes.definition: Versioned metric semantics with scope, unit, denominator and missing-value rules.

classes.label: Metric result
classes.definition: An observation for one metric and run; an unavailable value is not a zero.

classes.label: Business blueprint
classes.definition: A versioned data and process representation with source references and review state.

classes.label: Review record
classes.definition: A scoped review with reviewer role, provenance, decisions and unresolved disagreements.

classes.label: Index result
classes.definition: An aggregate result bound to an index definition and an eligible run; no current PBI result is asserted.

relationships.label: Exact configuration used by the run
Source collection included in the cohort
Blueprint produced by this run, where present
Index specification associated with a programme
Index definition applied to a result
Eligible run described by an index result

evaluation-dimension.label: Document fidelity
evaluation-dimension.definition: Faithfulness of extracted text, tables, formulas and layout to source documents.

evaluation-dimension.label: Semantic faithfulness
evaluation-dimension.definition: Preservation of meaning, ownership, negation, conditions and obligations.

evaluation-dimension.label: Coverage and uncertainty
evaluation-dimension.definition: Coverage of required facts and appropriate abstention where evidence is insufficient.

evaluation-dimension.label: ER, dictionary and ontology
evaluation-dimension.definition: Correct entities, attributes, definitions, types and relationships.

evaluation-dimension.label: Process fidelity
evaluation-dimension.definition: Preservation of actors, branches, permissions and exceptions.

evaluation-dimension.label: Governance controls
evaluation-dimension.definition: Review states, permitted actions and evidence of boundary enforcement.

evaluation-dimension.label: Reliability
evaluation-dimension.definition: Completion, failures, recovery and repeatability under declared conditions.

evaluation-dimension.label: Human effort and FinOps
evaluation-dimension.definition: Review and correction effort, resource use, charges and cost coverage.

evidence-provenance.label: Self-reported
evidence-provenance.definition: Evidence supplied by the participant; independent reproduction is not implied.

evidence-provenance.label: Maintainer-reproduced
evidence-provenance.definition: Execution reproduced or directly checked by a benchmark maintainer.

evidence-provenance.label: Independently reproduced
evidence-provenance.definition: Execution reproduced by an independent party with a traceable record.

qualification-state.label: Development
qualification-state.definition: Evidence from cases used during system development.

qualification-state.label: Pending review
qualification-state.definition: Evidence awaiting the declared qualification process.

qualification-state.label: Qualified
qualification-state.definition: Evidence satisfying a specified protocol and review decision within a declared scope.

index-availability.label: Unavailable
index-availability.definition: No eligible index result is available; do not replace with zero.

index-availability.label: Available
index-availability.definition: An index result exists with an identified definition, run and qualification decision.

interpretationRules: Evidence provenance, run completion and qualification are separate axes.
Independent reproduction does not by itself qualify a result.
Structural checks do not measure semantic correctness.
No PBI formula, weights, thresholds or results are assigned by this vocabulary.
OWL and SKOS describe terms and relations; they do not execute admission or qualification checks.
